Messages.Author: Boon Sian Chang
Messages.Body:
If the Tragic Love Affair is Played on Masika, can he still untap between
Methuslahs' turns?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Boon Sian Chang wrote:
>
> If the Tragic Love Affair is Played on Masika, can he still untap between
> Methuslahs' turns?

Yes. Note the wording on Tragic Love Affair: "... does not untap
during the untap phase."

It doesn't restrict untapping at other times, so Masika is welcomed
to use his special ability.
